entries.source: A good Bulwark is able to withstand terrible attacks from all sides, protected by her shield, and when the time comes lash out at her foes with incredible strength.
entries.target: 优秀的盾战士能凭借盾牌的保护承受来自四面八方的猛烈攻击，并在时机到来时以惊人的力量向敌人发起反击。

entries.source: Natural abilities can go beyond mere skill. Experience the true powers of nature to learn of its amazing gifts.
entries.target: 自然之能可以超越单纯的技艺。体验自然的真正力量，领略它奇妙的恩赐。

entries.source: They can take on the aspects of creatures, summon creatures to them, feel the druidic call, ...
entries.target: 他们可以获得各种生物的特质、将生物召唤到身边、感受德鲁伊的召唤……

entries.source: They have access to talents normally belonging to the various kind of drakes.
entries.target: 他们能使用通常属于各类龙的技能。

entries.source: Stone Wardens are dwarves trained in both the eldritch arts and the worship of nature.
entries.target: 岩石守卫是同时研习奥术技艺与自然崇拜的矮人。

entries.source: While other races are stuck in their belief that arcane forces and natural forces are meant to oppose, dwarves have found a way to combine them in harmony.
entries.target: 在其他种族受困于自然和魔法天生对立的偏见时，矮人们已经找到方法让这两种力量和谐共存。

entries.source: Stone Wardens are armoured fighters, dual wielding shields to channel many of their powers.
entries.target: 岩石守卫是身着重甲的战士，双持盾牌来施展技艺。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength, Magic and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量，魔力和意志

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +2 Strength, +0 Dexterity, +0 Constitution
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +2 力量，+0 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +4 Magic, +3 Willpower, +0 Cunning
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +4 魔力，+3 意志，+0 灵巧

entries.source: base
entries.target: 基础

entries.source: Tutorial
entries.target: 教程

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Tutorial mode
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#教程模式

entries.source: #WHITE#Start with a simplified character and discover the game in a simple quest.#{normal}#
entries.target: #WHITE#以一个简化的人物开始游戏并通过一个简单的任务来探索这个游戏。#{normal}#

entries.source: All damage done to the player reduced by 20%
entries.target: 角色所受伤害减少 20%

entries.source: All healing for the player increased by 10%
entries.target: 玩家受到的所有治疗效果增加 10%

entries.source: No main game achievements possible.
entries.target: 无法获得主游戏的成就。

entries.source: Easier
entries.target: 简单

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Easier mode#WHITE##{normal}#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#简单难度#WHITE##{normal}#

entries.source: Provides an easier game experience.
entries.target: 提供一个较简单的游戏体验。

entries.source: Use it if you feel uneasy tackling the harder modes.
entries.target: 其他难度游戏困难时请选择此模式。

entries.source: All damage done to the player decreased by 30%
entries.target: 角色所受所有伤害减少 30%

entries.source: All healing for the player increased by 30%
entries.target: 角色所受所有治疗增加 30%

entries.source: All detrimental status effects durations reduced by 50%
entries.target: 所有负面状态持续时间减少 50%

entries.source: Achievements are not granted.
entries.target: 不能完成游戏成就。

entries.source: Normal
entries.target: 普通

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Normal mode#WHITE##{normal}#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#普通难度#WHITE##{normal}#

entries.source: Provides the normal level of challenges.
entries.target: 普通难度的挑战。

entries.source: Stairs can not be used for 2 turns after a kill.
entries.target: 你杀死生物 2 回合内不能使用楼梯。

entries.source: Nightmare
entries.target: 梦魇

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Nightmare mode#WHITE##{normal}#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#噩梦难度#WHITE##{normal}#

entries.source: Unfair game setting
entries.target: 高难度游戏设定

entries.source: All zone levels increased by 25% by the time Player reaches level 10
entries.target: 玩家达到 10 级时，所有区域等级提高 25%

entries.source: All creature talent levels increased by 30%
entries.target: 所有生物技能等级提高 30%

entries.source: Unique (fixed) bosses advance in bonus classes 30% faster
entries.target: 独有（固定）Boss 的额外职业等级提升速度快 30%

entries.source: Rare creatures are slightly more frequent
entries.target: 稀有生物出现率略微增加

entries.source: Stairs can not be used for 3 turns after a kill.
entries.target: 你杀死生物 3 回合内不能使用楼梯。

entries.source: Player can earn Nightmare version of achievements if also playing in Roguelike or Adventure permadeath mode.
entries.target: 玩家如果选择永久死亡模式或冒险模式可以达成噩梦难度成就。

entries.source: Insane
entries.target: 疯狂

entries.source: Easy is for the weak! Normal is for the weak! Nightmare is too easy! Bring on the true pain!
entries.target: 简单难度，弱鸡！普通难度，菜鸟！噩梦难度，弱爆了！迎接真正的痛苦吧！

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Insane mode#WHITE##{normal}#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#疯狂难度#WHITE##{normal}#

entries.source: Similar rules to Nightmare, but with more random bosses!
entries.target: 和噩梦难度相似，但随机 Boss 出现更加频繁！

entries.source: All zone levels increased by 50% + 1 by the time Player reaches level 10
entries.target: 当玩家达到 10 级时，所有区域等级提高 50% + 1。

entries.source: All creature talent levels increased by 70%
entries.target: 所有生物技能等级增加 70%

entries.source: Unique (fixed) bosses advance in bonus classes 70% faster
entries.target: 独有（固定）Boss 的额外职业等级提升速度快 70%

entries.source: Rare creatures are far more frequent and random bosses start to appear
entries.target: 稀有怪出现频率大幅增加，同时出现随机 Boss

entries.source: Stairs can not be used for 5 turns after a kill.
entries.target: 你杀死生物 5 回合内不能使用楼梯。

entries.source: Player can earn Insane version of achievements if also playing in Roguelike or Adventure permadeath mode.
entries.target: 玩家如果选择永久死亡或冒险模式可以达成疯狂难度成就。

entries.source: Madness
entries.target: 绝望

entries.source: Insane is for the weak! Bring on the true mind-shattering experience!
entries.target: 疯狂难度也弱爆了！来体验真正让大脑崩溃的感觉吧！

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Madness mode#WHITE##{normal}#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#绝望难度#WHITE##{normal}#

entries.source: Absolutely unfair game setting. Prepare for the full wrath of DarkGod!
entries.target: 绝对不公平的游戏设定。感受DarkGod的愤怒吧！

entries.source: All zone levels increased by 150% + 2 by the time Player reaches level 10
entries.target: 当玩家达到 10 级时，所有区域等级提高 150% + 2。

entries.source: All creature talent levels increased by 170%
entries.target: 所有生物技能等级增加 170%

entries.source: Unique (fixed) bosses advance in bonus classes 170% faster
entries.target: 独有（固定）Boss 的额外职业等级提升速度快 170%

entries.source: All enemies have 200% more life
entries.target: 所有敌人血量增加 200%

entries.source: Stairs can not be used for 9 turns after a kill.
entries.target: 你杀死生物 9 回合内不能使用楼梯。

entries.source: Player starts with 100 more life and 500 gold, but trust us, you'll need it!
entries.target: 玩家起始获得100额外生命值和500金钱，相信我，你会用到它们的！

entries.source: Player is being hunted! Randomly all foes in a radius will get a feeling of where she/he is
entries.target: 玩家处于被捕猎的状态，随机地，一定半径内的所有敌人都会感知到你所在的位置。

entries.source: Player can earn Madness version of achievements if also playing in Roguelike or Adventure permadeath mode.
entries.target: 玩家如果选择永久死亡模式或冒险模式可以达成绝望难度成就。

entries.source: Exploration
entries.target: 探索模式

entries.source: Exploration mode: Infinite lives (donator feature)
entries.target: 探索模式：无限生命（捐赠者特权）

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Exploration mode#WHITE#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#探索模式#WHITE#

entries.source: Provides you with infinite lives.#{normal}#
entries.target: 拥有无限次生命。#{normal}#

entries.source: This is not the way the game is meant to be played, but it allows you to have a more forgiving experience.
entries.target: 这不是本游戏推荐的游戏方式，不过这也许能够让你有一个不那么痛苦的游戏经历。

entries.source: Remember though that dying is an integral part of the game and helps you become a better player.
entries.target: 请记住死也是游戏不可或缺的一部分，这可以帮助你成为一个更好的玩家。

entries.source: Exploration version of achievements will be granted in this mode.
entries.target: 此模式你可以完成探索模式成就。

entries.source: Full talent respec is always available.
entries.target: 此模式下你可以无限洗点。

entries.source: Adventure
entries.target: 冒险模式

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Adventure mode#WHITE#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#冒险模式#WHITE#

entries.source: Provides you with limited extra lives.
entries.target: 你拥有有限的额外生命。

entries.source: Use it if you want normal playing conditions but do not feel ready for just one life.#{normal}#
entries.target: 如果你想要普通的游戏条件、但还没准备好一条命通关，就选择这个模式。#{normal}#

entries.source: At level 1,2,5,7,14,24,35 get one more 'life' that allows you to resurrect at the start of the level.
entries.target: 在 1,2,5,7,14,24,35 级时各获得一条额外生命，可在本层起点复活。

entries.source: Roguelike
entries.target: 永久死亡模式

entries.source: #GOLD##{bold}#Roguelike mode#WHITE#
entries.target: #GOLD##{bold}#永久死亡模式#WHITE#

entries.source: Provides the closer experience to 'classic' roguelike games.
entries.target: 经典的 Roguelike 模式。

entries.source: You will only have one life; you *ARE* your character.#{normal}#
entries.target: 你就是这个角色，你只有一次生命机会。#{normal}#

entries.source: Only one life, unless ways to self-resurrect are found in-game.
entries.target: 只有一条命，除非你在游戏内找到自我复活的方法。
